description: Renames a Lovie account for display; the rename is also applied at the sponsor bank, so an error can mean the sponsor refused it and the name is unchanged. A linked account is refused. Set account_id to the id of the account to rename - get it from list_accounts, never from the conversation alone, and say which account you are renaming before you call this. Report the name the call returned, not the one you sent. Requires the banking.account.update permission.
name: account_update_account_display_name
title: Update Account Display Name
